system.summary: Tokyo → Military Affairs Council (Zhaoqing) and Shanghai, June–September 1916. Coordinate grid of 20 consonants × 5 vowels, recovered in October 2026.

prior_solution.where: Not in this repository (pointer only in sunyatsen/y1916); no decipherment on the JACAR copies; Cryptiana checked.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules and re-read doubtful letters on the scans in blind panels; AI agents transcribed, searched the condenser family, decoded and translated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Telegrams transcribed from the JACAR PDFs; doubtful letters re-read by Brice Dudout in blind panels.
Search of the condenser family (consonant rotation, vowel order) scored with a Chinese character model; key accepted only if it read telegrams it was not fitted to.
Chinese text punctuated and translated; doubtful codes marked.
Read share recounted with sure codes only (README rule of PR #728) from the status column of decryption.txt: 341 of 351 codes (0.972); 1 of 7 telegrams under 95%; class read -> read in part.
Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026: under 40 codes, at most 2 holes) applied to the 18 Nov counts: no document qualifies; class stays read in part.

validation.notes: Chinese plaintext through the telegraph code: the letter n-gram test cannot run on Chinese characters; the readings were checked by sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: Sure codes only (18 Nov 2026): 341 of 351 codes marked ok (or confirmed) in decryption.txt; doubtful and illegible codes are holes; 1 of 7 telegrams under 95%. Before: probable (doubtful) codes counted as read. Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026): no document qualifies; 0386 (35/38) stay under the bar, so the class stays read in part.

credits.note: Grid G0 — “文密”: key and 7 telegram(s) read, with transcriptions, decryptions, Chinese texts and English translations

gaps.detail: copying and transmission errors on the Japanese copies

texts.label: Grid G0 — “文密”: 7 telegram(s), 23 June 1916 - 30 September 1916
texts.summary: Tokyo → Military Affairs Council (Zhaoqing) and Shanghai, June–September 1916. Coordinate grid of 20 consonants × 5 vowels, recovered in October 2026.

reading_review.note: 7 telegrams; 0348, 0416b, 0455b, 0462 read as clean telegram Chinese and 0415 nearly so, but 0406 carries about ten wrong characters marked 'ok' in decryption.txt (誕 for 誠, 日放廈 for 日政府, 對五, 厚, 丕, 已夕牡, 可峻, 塞械, 大岸望), which the translation silently emends, and 0386 is largely fragmentary (自頗坎發, 萬密準{侃}...).

texts.note: 18 Nov 2026, sure codes only: 64 of 64 codes "ok" in decryption.txt (100.0%); codes marked doubtful (douteux, {x} in reading.md) or illegible are holes.
